edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose.
edits.reason: The trailing 'rather than by accident' is the ordinary-knowledge antonym of 'on purpose' (the rule's own example) and adds nothing, so it is cut.

edits.original: Conservation collections still accession landraces, rather than heirlooms.
edits.replacement: Conservation collections still accession landraces—locally adapted, genetically diverse traditional crop varieties.
edits.reason: 'Rather than heirlooms' is a genuine specialist distinction (landrace vs. heirloom is not ordinary-knowledge antonymy), so it is not cut but restated positively as what landraces are, per the rule.

edits.original: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, not nuclear transformation.
edits.replacement: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, integrating the transgene into the chloroplast genome.
edits.reason: 'Not nuclear transformation' is a genuine domain distinction tacked on as a trailer, so it is restated positively as what the construct does (integrate the transgene into the chloroplast genome) rather than what it isn't.
